sensing_resource.note: all 256 communication OFDM symbols are reused for sensing

visibility.status: CANDIDATE (from the adaptation audit, not frozen)

detector.path: range FFT -> Doppler FFT -> RD power -> physical ROI -> local maxima -> NMS -> sub-bin interpolation -> AoA FFT -> multi-angle peaks
detector.parameter_rationale: rd floor 20 dB above the RD median sits ~15 dB above the observed noise-only maximum (+4.5 dB) and above the Hann sidelobe ring beyond the NMS radius at the top of the sweep; NMS radius 5 covers the first Hann sidelobe ring (measured at +-4..5 bins); AoA peaks must beat the RD-median noise reference by 10 dB and stay within 10 dB of the strongest angle peak (rect array first sidelobe is -13.3 dB)

count_mismatch_note: GT count is used only here, after the detector, to report count consistency; it never enters the detector.
